title: Clip validation is size>0 only: a clip whose window lies beyond the media end is reported extracted and the raw media is then deleted; no ffprobe/duration check
repro: Real ffmpeg 9.0.2, 10 s mp4. extractEvidenceClips window 50-60 s => ok:true, extracted, 16270 bytes, ffprobe duration 1.22 s (not the cited moment). Also windows are never compared with media duration.
fix_direction: After ffmpeg, ffprobe the clip: require it to be a parseable container, duration >= (window length - tolerance), and reject windows with tStart >= media duration. Add a test with real or faked ffprobe.
resolution: Verified at fix cycle 1 (commit 5bb3a5e0): recorded reproductions re-run with real ffmpeg/ffprobe; mutants killed.

title: A pre-existing non-empty clip file is trusted ('exists') without validation, so a truncated or garbage clip left by a crashed or killed ffmpeg lets the raw media be deleted
repro: Wrote 18 bytes of junk to evidence-clips/S1__t4.mp4; extractEvidenceClips returned ok:true status exists; ffprobe: moov atom not found. Mutation M12 (exists check loosened) survives all tests. ffmpeg is also not writing to a temp name, so a killed run leaves a partial file at the final name.
fix_direction: Write to <name>.partial then validate (ffprobe) then rename; on re-run validate existing clips with ffprobe instead of size>0.
resolution: Verified at fix cycle 1 (commit 5bb3a5e0): recorded reproductions re-run with real ffmpeg/ffprobe; mutants killed.

title: scripts/retention/schedule-retention-purge.ps1 defaults -ReportFile to data/retention/last-run.json, and the job CLI also writes last-run.json to the same default: the full JobReport is overwritten by the summary and reportFile points at itself
repro: By code reading: schedule-retention-purge.ps1 line 29 ReportFile default and retention-purge-job-cli.ts lastRunFile default are the same path; runPurgeJob writes report then last-run.
fix_direction: Give the full report a distinct default (e.g. data/retention/report.json) or reject equal paths.
resolution: Verified at fix cycle 1 (commit 5bb3a5e0): recorded reproductions re-run with real ffmpeg/ffprobe; mutants killed.

title: Gaps: markSessionProcessed atomic-write (temp+rename) mutation survives; processedAt trusts session.json status only (no index-proof.json check); read-modify-write has no lock; evidence-clips dir as a junction is followed; library executePurge without deps.clips still deletes with no clips
repro: Mutation M10 (write directly to final path) survived 3 test files.
fix_direction: Add a test asserting rename is used; consider an index-proof check; lstat the evidence-clips dir; make clips mandatory in execute mode.
resolution: Verified at fix cycle 1 (commit 5bb3a5e0): recorded reproductions re-run with real ffmpeg/ffprobe; mutants killed.
